# Corporate Gifting India – Heritage Bags & Pouches \| The House of RajPadmini

**Corporate gifts that don't end up in someone's drawer.**

Most corporate gifts are forgotten by the time the festive Monday arrives. Dry fruit hampers get eaten. Coffee mugs collect on shelves. Power banks get lost. We make a different kind of corporate gift — handcrafted quilted cotton bags from Jaipur that your team and clients actually carry, every day, for years. The kind of gift where someone three months later still asks "wait, where did this come from?"

## Why companies choose The House of RajPadmini

We're a Jaipur-based heritage bag brand. Hand block-printed quilted cotton, diamond-stitched, made by craftspeople from the Sanganer and Bagru workshop tradition. Every bag in our catalogue has a story — and that story is what makes them work as corporate gifts.

Companies that have ordered from us for Diwali, employee onboarding, client appreciation, conference welcome kits, and wedding return gifts have one thing in common: they wanted to give something more memorable than the standard hamper-and-card combo. Our bags do that without needing a logo printed on them. The print, the craftsmanship, and the made-in-India story do the heavy lifting.

[Browse the full corporate gifting collection →](https://thehouseofrajpadmini.in/collections/corporate-gifting-heritage-bags-pouches-for-diwali-onboarding-client-gifts)

## How ordering works

### Step 1: Browse and shortlist

Look through the [Corporate Gifting collection](https://thehouseofrajpadmini.in/collections/corporate-gifting-heritage-bags-pouches-for-diwali-onboarding-client-gifts) and pick the products that fit your budget and brief. If you're not sure what's right, write to us with your headcount, budget per gift, and use case — we'll suggest the best options.

### Step 2: Tell us your quantity

For orders of 5–24 units, simply place the order on the website and select your preferred products. For orders of 25+ units, write to us first — we'll quote volume pricing and confirm stock availability for your timeline.

### Step 3: Volume pricing & timelines

We offer indicative volume discounts as follows (final pricing depends on product mix and timing):

| Order size | Indicative discount | Lead time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 25–49 units | 5–8% off list price | 5–7 working days |
| 50–99 units | 8–12% off list price | 7–10 working days |
| 100–249 units | 12–15% off list price | 10–14 working days |
| 250+ units | Custom pricing — write to us | 14–21 working days |

### Step 4: Delivery

We ship across India. For corporate orders, we can deliver to a single corporate address or split-ship to individual employee/client addresses (small split-ship fee applies). Free shipping on the standard order. COD available on regular orders; for bulk orders we typically work on advance + balance terms.

## What makes our gifts different

### 1\. They're functional, not decorative

Coffee mugs and photo frames sit on a desk. Our quilted bags get used. Travel pouch sets travel with the recipient on every trip. Quilted totes become someone's everyday carrier. The longer your gift gets used, the longer your brand stays present in your team's or client's life.

### 2\. The Indian heritage angle is real

We aren't a marketplace stocking generic import bags. Every bag is hand block-printed in Sanganer or Bagru, by craftspeople using techniques passed down through generations. The 400-year-old Rajasthani textile tradition isn't a marketing line — it's the actual production method. For corporate clients who want to support Indian artisans (especially MNCs with sustainability and CSR mandates), this matters.

### 3\. They scale across budgets

Most corporate gifting providers have a narrow price band. Our quilted gifting range covers ₹399 (single multi-purpose pouch) to ₹1,599 (premium 5-piece combo). You can give different tiers to different audiences — junior team gets a pouch, senior leadership gets a combo, top clients get the laptop tote — all from one brand, one aesthetic, one supplier.

### 4\. No two batches look identical

This is feature, not a bug. Hand block printing produces slight variation between pieces — different positioning of motifs, mild color depth variation, individual character. For corporate gifting, this means recipients can tell their gift wasn't picked from a generic warehouse. It feels personal even without personalization.

### 5\. Made in India, for India

If you've ever ordered "premium imported" corporate gifts and dealt with customs, you know the pain. Our entire supply chain is in Rajasthan. No customs holdups. No import duties. No "stuck in Mumbai port" delays. Order today, deliver next week.

## Bulk inquiry: get a custom quote

For orders of 25+ units, write to us with the details below and we'll come back to you within 24 hours with a quote, stock availability, and delivery timeline.

**Email us at:** [hello@thehouseofrajpadmini.com](mailto:hello@thehouseofrajpadmini.com)

**WhatsApp:** Message us via the chat widget on the bottom right of any page.

**What to include in your inquiry:**

1. Company name and your role
2. Approximate quantity needed
3. Budget per gift (or total budget)
4. Use case — Diwali, onboarding, client gifts, wedding, conference, etc.
5. Timeline / delivery date needed by
6. Single delivery address or split-ship to multiple addresses
7. Any specific products you've already shortlisted (with links if possible)

## Frequently asked questions

### What's the minimum order quantity?

There is no minimum. You can order a single unit if you'd like to send one client gift. Volume discounts kick in from 25 units and scale up from there.

### Can you customize the bags with our company logo?

Not at the moment. Our positioning is "curated heritage gifts" — products that are memorable because of their craft and origin, not because of branding on them. For most corporate gifting use cases, this works in your favour: recipients keep using a bag with a beautiful Jaipur block print, whereas they'd often retire one with a corporate logo on it. If logo branding is essential for your brief, we may not be the right fit — but if you're open to a different kind of gift, we tend to be the right fit.

### Can you do custom packaging?

For very large orders (250+ units) we can discuss branded gift packaging or insert cards. For standard orders, gifts ship in our standard heritage packaging — which is itself a strong unboxing experience.

### What's the typical lead time for bulk orders?

5–7 working days for orders of 25–49 units. Up to 21 working days for orders of 250+ units. For Diwali season, we recommend confirming orders by mid-September to ensure on-time delivery.

### Do you split-ship to multiple addresses?

Yes. For employees working from different cities or for VIP client lists, we can ship individual units to individual addresses. A small split-shipping fee applies, calculated based on the number of distinct addresses.

### What's your return policy on bulk orders?

For corporate orders, we accept returns on defective or damaged units (replaced free of charge). Bulk orders, by their nature, are non-returnable unless there's a quality issue — please confirm your selection before placing the order.

### Can we get a sample before ordering?

Yes. For potential bulk orders of 50+ units, we can ship 1–3 sample products at standard retail price. If you proceed with the bulk order, we'll credit the sample cost against your final invoice.

### Do you provide GST invoices?

Yes. All our orders come with proper GST-compliant invoices. We're a registered business based in Jaipur, Rajasthan.

## Recommended starting points by budget

### If your budget is ₹400–₹600 per gift

Best fit: Single quilted multi-purpose pouches in coordinated colors. Recipient gets a useful, beautiful piece they'll actually carry. Browse [quilted pouches](https://thehouseofrajpadmini.in/collections/quilted-pouches).

### If your budget is ₹700–₹900 per gift

Best fit: Quilted Travel Pouch Set of 3 (large + medium + small). The most-loved corporate gift in our range. Especially strong for Diwali employee gifting and conference welcome kits.

### If your budget is ₹1,000–₹1,400 per gift

Best fit: 4-in-1 Festive Gifting Combo (tote + 3 pouches). Excellent for client appreciation, wedding return gifts, and senior team Diwali gifts.

### If your budget is ₹1,500+ per gift

Best fit: Quilted Laptop Tote with matching pouch, or 5-piece Valentine's Combo (sunglass cover + tote + pouch). Reserved for VIP clients, leadership team, and high-impact gifts.

_Have a brief that doesn't fit a standard category? Write to us. We've helped companies put together corporate gifts for product launches, employee anniversaries, IPO celebrations, and customer milestone events — anything where a thoughtful, made-in-India gift is the right call._
